title: Traditional British Shepherds Pie
description: A classic comfort food dish from the UK, made with ground meat, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.
instructions: In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and peas to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle the flour over the top and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes evenly over the top of the meat mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
